evidence.evidence: We present sentiment analyzer (SA) that extracts sentiment (or opinion) about a subject from online text documents.
Our sentiment analysis consists of 1) a topic specific feature term extraction, 2) sentiment extraction, and 3) (subject, sentiment) association by relationship analysis.
